items.title: Senior Product Manager, Advisor Marketplace
items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers, sharp problem-solvers, and builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency – it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Advisory Products team is redefining the advisor experience by bringing the best of Robinhood’s technology, design, and infrastructure to Registered Investment Advisors (RIAs) and the clients they serve. Following our TradePMR acquisition, we’re building a modern advisor platform – custody, tools, and a two-sided marketplace that connects Robinhood’s investors with trusted, growth-oriented advisors. As the Product Manager for the Advisor Marketplace, you will own the product that helps investors find, meet, and fund accounts with the right advisor – and helps advisors win and onboard those clients efficiently. You’ll own the full marketplace funnel, from demand generation and matching through first meeting, onboarding, and funded account, and you’ll use data and experimentation to make every step work better for both sides. This is an opportunity to take a new, high-visibility business from early traction to scale, in close partnership with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, Operations, and Compliance. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Advisor Marketplace, balancing the needs of both sides – investors looking for advice and advisors looking to grow their practices. Own the end-to-end marketplace funnel – discovery, matching and routing, scheduling, first-meeting show rate, advisor onboarding, and funded accounts – and drive measurable improvements at each stage. Define and manage marketplace health: supply and demand balance, advisor quality and standards, lead allocation, and conversion, with clear metrics such as meetings booked and completed, accounts funded, assets under management, and net flows. Partner with Engineering, Design, and Data Science to ship products from concept to production, using research, experimentation, and analytics to guide prioritization and measure success. Work with Compliance, Legal, and Risk to embed regulatory and operational requirements directly into product design, advisor vetting, disclosures, and workflows. Integrate the marketplace with the broader RIA platform, including TradePMR and Robinhood’s app, so that advisor and client data, accounts, and custody flows connect seamlessly. Drive go-to-market execution with Marketing, Sales, and Operations across launches, advisor acquisition and onboarding, support readiness, and cross-functional communication. Explore how AI can improve the client experience when working with an advisor. Stay ahead of trends in wealth management, advisor technology, and marketplaces to inform long-term strategy. What you bring 4+ years of product management experience, including building and launching marketplace, platform, or complex multi-sided products, ideally in fintech, brokerage, or wealth management. Demonstrated success owning a funnel or growth-oriented product end-to-end, with a track record of improving conversion and engagement through experimentation and analytics. Experience delivering products in a regulated or compliance-heavy environment, balancing innovation with operational and regulatory rigor. Strong analytical skills: you define success metrics, write your own queries or dashboards, and use data to drive prioritization and continuous improvement. Strong technical acumen and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, and operations teams on system design, integrations, and scalability. Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to align diverse stakeholders – including executives, advisors, and partner teams – around a shared roadmap. An ownership mindset and a scrappy, self-starter attitude: comfortable with ambiguity, able to define what “great” looks like as you go. Passion for empowering financial advisors and their clients, and for transforming the wealth management industry through modern technology. Bonus points Experience building two-sided marketplaces, lead-generation or referral products, or CRM and scheduling workflows. Experience shipping AI-enabled features in B2B or consumer products. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Best-in-class benefits, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Lifestyle wallet – a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge, including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $166,000 — $195,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $146,000 — $172,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $129,000 — $152,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. items.title: VIP Relationship Manager, LATAM
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Our VIP team supports the firm's highest-value private clients across the Payward ecosystem: high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) who expect a premium, secure, and highly tailored experience. We ensure Kraken remains the platform of choice for VIPs by delivering white-glove relationship management, personalized trading enablement, and high-impact benefits. We are looking for a Senior VIP Relationship Manager, LATAM to help us scale our VIP client book and growth across the region. This is a hybrid role: part white-glove relationship management, part growth and business development. You'll build Kraken's presence inside LATAM's VIP trading and investor communities, run local marketing and events, and source new whale relationships. We're looking for someone who isn't afraid to be bold, can build and scale initiatives from the ground up, and is humble enough to fail fast and move on to the next challenge. If you thrive in ambiguity and can operate in a fast-paced, scrappy environment, this role is for you. THE OPPORTUNITY - Serve as the trusted point of contact for Kraken and Payward’s top private clients across LATAM, delivering consistent, high-quality white-glove service and building deep, durable relationships. - Own the regional VIP book end to end: onboarding, tier progression, retention, and proactive intervention on at-risk and lapsing clients. - Build lasting relationships that grow AOP, net deposits, and trading volume, your primary KPIs, by becoming the partner clients trust with more of their capital and activity over time. - Bring Kraken's private client and VIP offerings to market locally, including yield and earn campaigns, lending against tokenized equities and crypto collateral, OTC execution, and structured private-client benefits, ensuring they remain impactful and competitive against regional exchanges and desks. - Source and convert new HNWI relationships through direct outreach, referrals, and introducer networks, from crypto-wealthy individuals and family offices to the principals of trading firms, OTC desks, miners, and project treasuries. - Get inside LATAM's VIP trading communities: private trading groups, investor clubs, KOL and trader networks, and closed-door investor groups. Be the Kraken face those communities know and trust. - Design and run local marketing and events (VIP dinners, trader meetups, conference-adjacent programming, and co-marketing with regional partners and KOLs) in partnership with our Marketing and Regional teams. - Build and manage introducer and referral partnerships that produce a repeatable pipeline of qualified private clients. - Act as Payward’s ear on the ground: competitive intelligence on regional exchanges, product gaps that cost us whale business, and the local narratives that move capital. - Partner with Product, Marketing, Compliance, Banking, and Client Service to champion new efforts that drive private client growth and loyalty, and to make sure every play you run is inside Kraken's licensing and compliance perimeter. WHAT YOU BRING - 5+ years of experience in relationship management, account management, private banking, brokerage, or private client sales, including at least 2 years in the crypto space, with a track record of working with HNWIs. - An existing, personal network among LATAM's crypto HNWIs, traders, family offices, OTC desks, funds, or trading communities in Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, or Chile. - Demonstrated ability to originate business, not just service it. You have personally brought in clients, run events, or built a community presence that produced measurable pipeline. - Deep understanding of trading product solutions, including spot, margin, and futures trading, as well as OTC trading, lending, and yield/earn products. Familiarity with how deposits and client balances drive an exchange's lending economics is a strong plus. - Comfort operating in a regulated environment across multiple LATAM jurisdictions, and the judgment to know when to involve Compliance early. - Highly data-driven, with expertise in analyzing KPIs such as assets on platform, net deposits, trading volume, and client portfolio revenue. - Ability to be scrappy, bold, and unafraid to explore alternative and creative solutions to achieve results. - Deep knowledge of cryptocurrency ecosystems, their players, frameworks, and market dynamics beyond just blue-chip tokens, including how local on/off-ramps and stablecoin flows shape client behavior in the region. - Skilled at building meaningful partnerships with internal and external stakeholders at all levels and across diverse backgrounds. - Willingness to travel up to 30% across the region for client meetings, events, and conferences. - Based in Brazil and native or near-native Portuguese plus fluent English required. Spanish is a strong plus. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. About the Opportunity MoonPay is building a developer platform that allows partners to create native payment and crypto experiences directly inside their own products. Historically, partners integrated MoonPay through a hosted widget and redirected users into a fixed MoonPay journey. We are now breaking the underlying system into reusable modules covering authentication, identity, KYC, quotes, payment methods and purchasing. These capabilities are exposed through APIs, SDKs, embedded components, iframes and web views. Our goal is for a partner developer to integrate MoonPay’s full capabilities without needing ongoing implementation support from our team. This role owns the developer-facing layer between MoonPay’s underlying payments infrastructure and the products our partners build. You will work across browsers, mobile applications and backend APIs to make complex financial workflows feel simple, predictable and native. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will hold a hands-on technical position. You will build the platform itself rather than implementing one-off integrations for individual customers. Build the developer platform Design and build APIs, SDKs and embedded components used by external developers. Turn MoonPay’s existing authentication, identity, payment and purchasing capabilities into reusable platform modules. Develop secure browser and mobile integration patterns across iframes, web views and native applications. Create stable abstractions over complex payments, compliance and crypto infrastructure. Build reference applications, sandboxes and tooling that help developers move quickly from exploration to production. Understand the integration deeply Own the complete developer journey, from obtaining credentials through to completing a live transaction. Design clear interfaces for sessions, authentication, quotes, payment methods, transaction state and errors. Handle the realities of browser and mobile environments, including cross-origin communication, redirects, storage restrictions and application lifecycle events. Develop consistent behaviour across web, iOS and Android integrations. Ensure integrations remain secure when operating inside products MoonPay does not control. Make complex systems easy to use Design APIs and SDKs that are difficult to misuse and straightforward to debug. Establish clear versioning, compatibility and migration strategies. Build documentation around how developers actually use the platform rather than treating it as a secondary deliverable. Create useful errors, logs and observability so partners can resolve issues without contacting MoonPay. Reduce integration time and the amount of direct support required from engineering. Operate payment-critical software Build systems where failures can prevent a customer from completing a purchase or leave a partner uncertain about transaction state. Design for retries, duplicate events, delayed responses and dependencies failing in unexpected ways. Implement idempotency, state recovery and graceful degradation across distributed payment flows. Measure API and SDK adoption, integration success, reliability and developer experience. Safely evolve the platform as MoonPay adds products, payment methods, regions and partners. About You Must-have experience and skills External developer products. You have built APIs, SDKs, embedded components or integration tooling used by third-party developers. Browser or mobile depth. You understand how browsers and mobile applications behave beneath the framework level, including sessions, storage, cross-origin communication and embedded experiences. JavaScript and TypeScript. You have strong language fundamentals and have built production client-side or SDK infrastructure. API and SDK design. You understand versioning, backwards compatibility, documentation, error design and safe migrations. Distributed systems. You build correctly when events arrive twice, late or out of order and when dependencies fail. Product judgement. You can turn complex platform capabilities into interfaces that developers can understand and adopt. Ownership. You have taken developer-facing software from design through launch, adoption and ongoing production support. Nice-to-have experience Built payment APIs, checkout SDKs, embedded financial products or payment-method integrations. Built products similar to Stripe Elements, Stripe.js, Plaid Link or Braintree’s client SDKs. Experience with secure iframes, web views, postMessage or cross-origin browser infrastructure. Developed SDKs across web, iOS or Android. Built sandboxes, test environments, reference applications or developer documentation. Experience with webhooks, idempotency, transaction state machines and payment orchestration. Worked on authentication, identity or KYC integrations. Familiarity with cryptocurrency, wallets or digital-asset products. Familiarity with our stack: TypeScript, Node.js, React, GCP, PostgreSQL, Redis and Kubernetes. items.title: (Senior) Product Manager - Customer Taxation (m/f/d)
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t. We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require. Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind. Your Responsibilities You will own a regulated domain that customers depend on every tax year. Working with an experienced Engineering Lead, you will become the go-to expert for customer taxation at Raisin. Own customer taxation end to end: Define the vision and roadmap together with Product and Engineering leadership. Take each topic from discovery to delivery to measured impact. Decide what we build first, and keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, risks and trade-offs. Keep tax accurate and reliable: Agree with Legal, Compliance and country managers on what correct looks like. Work with Engineering so calculation, documents and reporting stay stable and easy to extend. Grow Raisin’s tax proposition: Shape how tax works when Raisin enters new markets, launches tax-advantaged products or brings on new partners. Find where we can take tax work off customers’ hands, so they don’t have to declare and settle it themselves. Turn complex rules into simple experiences: Translate the tax rules behind each launch into clear requirements with the edge cases covered. Design the customer experience and see the work through to delivery. Hit the deadlines that cannot move: Make sure annual tax documents and statutory reports go out correct and on time, working with Product Operations. Plan backwards from fixed dates and monitor data quality. Catch errors before they reach customers, and escalate early when a date is at risk. Make tax effortless for customers: Keep self-service for tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates intuitive, so customers get them right the first time. Give Customer Service the tools to answer tax questions fast, especially around tax season. Shape the team culture: Give and ask for feedback openly, share wins with the team, and treat mistakes as a reason to fix the process. Your Profile Must haves: 3+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a technical product such as a back-end, platform or data-heavy service. Experience leading a cross-functional product team and getting engineers and stakeholders behind shared priorities. Experience launching new products or taking products into new markets, with the precision to get every edge case right, because one wrong tax rule can affect thousands of customers. Strong analytical skills and the habit of checking and reconciling numbers yourself. Curiosity about tax and a drive to make it feel easy for customers, even when the rules behind it are not. The ability to learn fast, take feedback well and change course when new facts come in. Energy, a strong work ethic and a hands-on attitude to detailed work. Clear, structured written English, and the confidence to explain trade-offs to senior leaders and say no with a reason. Nice to haves: Experience in a regulated field such as banking, payments, insurance or tax technology. Strong knowledge of the tax regime in one or more of Raisin’s markets, for example Germany (Abgeltungsteuer, tax exemption orders), or of statutory reporting such as CRS. Tax knowledge is not required. We will teach you. You have built tools for operations or customer service teams. Important attributes for this role: You bridge product and engineering. You are comfortable discussing data models and architecture trade-offs, and you push for practical solutions that scale. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year. Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days. A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%. Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month. Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs. Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office. You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation. Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. items.title: CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager
items.description: Better Collective is looking for an experienced CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager to establish and lead a group-wide approach to customer relationship management across our portfolio of global sports media brands. This is a senior role combining CRM strategy, customer lifecycle management, technology, data, commercial thinking and operational leadership . The successful candidate will move CRM beyond campaign execution and develop it as a strategic capability that helps Better Collective build deeper, more valuable relationships with its audiences. Working across Product, Audience, Data, Commercial, Editorial, Technology and local brand teams, the CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will create the frameworks, programmes and operating model required to turn first- and zero-party audience data into personalised customer experiences and measurable business value. The Opportunity Better Collective reaches millions of sports fans across a diverse portfolio of digital brands. The next stage of our audience strategy is to develop stronger direct relationships with those users — moving from anonymous audiences → known users → understood customers → engaged and valuable relationships . CRM will be central to that transformation. The CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will establish the strategy, capabilities and standards that allow Better Collective brands to acquire, activate, engage, retain and monetise audiences across the customer lifecycle. Key Responsibilities CRM Strategy & Leadership Develop Better Collective's group-wide CRM and lifecycle strategy. Establish CRM principles, standards and best practices across brands. Create a scalable operating model balancing central CRM expertise with local brand execution. Identify where CRM can deliver the greatest audience and commercial impact. Build CRM roadmaps for priority Better Collective brands. Act as the senior CRM subject-matter expert across the organisation. Customer Lifecycle Management Design lifecycle strategies covering: Acquisition → Registration → Onboarding → Engagement → Conversion → Retention → Reactivation Develop automated programmes including: Welcome and onboarding journeys Profile completion Content discovery Personalised sports and player updates Newsletter engagement Subscription conversion Premium product promotion Renewal Retention Churn prevention Lapsed-user reactivation Win-back programmes The objective is to create relevant, personalised experiences rather than simply increase communication volume. First & Zero-Party Data Activation Work closely with Audience, Product and Data teams to translate Better Collective's growing first- and zero-party data capabilities into meaningful customer experiences. Use behavioural, declared and transactional data to improve: Audience segmentation Personalisation Content recommendations Lifecycle triggers Subscription propensity Retention Cross-sell opportunities Audience insight Help establish the connection between data capture, customer understanding and CRM activation . Multi-Channel CRM Develop a coordinated CRM approach across: Email Newsletters App push Web push In-app messaging On-site messaging Emerging direct audience channels Establish channel roles, contact strategies, frequency management and customer communication principles. Ensure customers receive coordinated experiences rather than disconnected messages from individual channels. CRM Technology & Automation Partner with Product and Technology teams to maximise Better Collective's CRM technology stack. Responsibilities include: Marketing automation Journey orchestration Audience segmentation Triggered communications Dynamic content Personalisation CRM/CDP integration Data flows Preference management Testing frameworks Reporting requirements Help translate business and customer requirements into practical technology capabilities. Measurement & Optimisation Create a consistent CRM measurement framework across Better Collective. Core metrics should include: Known-user growth Registration conversion Newsletter acquisition Email engagement Push engagement Active-user frequency Subscription conversion Renewal Retention Reactivation Revenue per known user Customer lifetime value Move CRM measurement beyond opens and clicks toward customer behaviour and commercial outcomes . Experimentation Establish a structured CRM experimentation programme covering: A/B testing Send frequency Timing Content Segmentation Personalisation Offers Lifecycle triggers Channel combinations Create mechanisms for successful experiments to be documented and scaled across Better Collective brands. Stakeholder Leadership CRM at Better Collective sits across multiple disciplines. The CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will therefore work closely with: Audience — audience strategy, segmentation and zero/first-party data Product — registration, logged-in experiences and product journeys Data & BI — customer data, segmentation and measurement Technology — CRM platforms, integrations and automation Editorial — content propositions and newsletters Commercial — monetisation and customer value Subscription Teams — acquisition, renewal and retention Compliance — consent, GDPR, PECR and data governance Strong stakeholder leadership will be critical to the success of the role. We are looking for an experienced CRM leader who combines strategic thinking with the ability to turn strategy into operational programmes. The successful candidate will ideally have: Significant experience leading CRM, lifecycle or customer engagement programmes. Strong knowledge of email marketing and marketing automation. Experience developing sophisticated customer lifecycle strategies. Strong understanding of customer segmentation and personalisation. Experience working with large customer databases. Experience using behavioural and transactional data to improve communications. Strong understanding of CRM technology and platform capabilities. Experience working across Product, Data, Technology, Marketing and Commercial teams. Excellent stakeholder management skills. Experience managing CRM teams, agencies or specialist partners. Strong analytical and commercial mindset. Demonstrable experience connecting CRM activity to measurable business outcomes. Experience within digital media, subscriptions, publishing, sports, gaming or high-frequency digital consumer products would be particularly valuable. Leadership Profile The role requires someone who can operate at both strategic and practical levels. You should be comfortable moving between: Strategy ↔ Execution Customer ↔ Commercial Data ↔ Communications Technology ↔ Marketing Central Strategy ↔ Local Brand Requirements You will need to influence senior stakeholders while also being comfortable working directly with teams responsible for delivering CRM programmes. What Success Looks Like First 3 Months Audit CRM capabilities across priority Better Collective brands. Establish baseline CRM KPIs. Map existing lifecycle communications. Identify immediate optimisation opportunities. Define the group CRM strategy and operating principles. Prioritise brands and lifecycle use cases. 3–6 Months Launch priority automated lifecycle programmes. Establish group segmentation principles. Introduce a structured CRM experimentation framework. Establish CRM dashboards and commercial measurement. Develop CRM playbooks that can be reused across brands. 6–12 Months Better Collective has a scalable CRM capability connecting: Audience Data → Customer Insight → Segmentation → Personalisation → Activation → Measurement → Commercial Value CRM becomes a measurable growth engine supporting: Audience Engagement | Registration | Subscription | Retention | Revenue | Customer Lifetime Value Why This Role Matters Better Collective already has significant global audience scale. The opportunity is to build stronger direct relationships with those audiences. This role will help Better Collective transition from primarily understanding what audiences consume to understanding who our customers are, what they value and how we can build longer-lasting relationships with them . The CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will be central to making that transition happen.

items.title: Research Engineer, Latency & Throughput
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a Research Engineer on the Latency & Throughput team, you will push the frontier of LLM inference by researching and prototyping techniques that reduce latency and increase throughput — from speculative decoding and quantization to KV compression and new attention variants. The team sits at the intersection of research and production: you will take ideas from recent literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and ship the techniques that prove out into our serving stack. This role sits between our inference engineers, who own the production serving stack, and our research scientists, who focus on paper-level contributions. You will be more science-focused than a pure engineer: you are expected to generate new ideas, keep up with the state of the art, and implement proof-of-concepts that bridge the gap between academic results and production impact. Some techniques you explore will be lossy or require integration into training — retraining models, tuning architectures, or training auxiliary models to improve inference. You will work closely with the Inference Foundation and Kernels teams, who turn your validated techniques into production recipes, and with pretraining and RL teams when your work touches model training. Success is measured by demonstrated latency or throughput gains, first at small scale, then adopted in production. What You Will Do - Research and prototype inference techniques — speculative decoding, quantization, KV compression, watermarking, and new model architectures — by reading recent literature and forming testable hypotheses. - Design and run experiments to validate or refute ideas, iterating quickly on small-scale setups before proposing production integration. Demonstrate clear latency or throughput gains without unacceptable quality loss. - Collaborate with the Inference Foundation team to integrate validated techniques into the vLLM-based serving stack. - Partner with pretraining and RL teams when techniques require co-training, retraining, or training auxiliary models to improve inference. Build the right tooling and validation platforms to facilitate AI-driven inference research. What We're Looking For - A strong ML background with solid knowledge of LLM training techniques — architecture, tokenization, fine-tuning, and evaluation. - Hands-on experience with Python and PyTorch; you write clean, experimental code and iterate fast. JAX is acceptable with strong Python proficiency. C++ and Rust are not required, CUDA and GPU knowledge is expected but hands-on experience is not required. - Research experience of some form: a thesis, publications, a dedicated research project, or efficiency-oriented work in a lab or industry research setting. A PhD is not required, but we are looking for genuine research depth. - A track record of conducting experiments: forming hypotheses, designing controlled comparisons, and drawing clear conclusions from results. - Familiarity with the state of the art in LLM inference — you know what has been tried, what works, and where the open problems are. - Self-starter, low-ego, and collaborative. You are comfortable with ambiguity, negative results, and are eager to take matters into your own hands. - Inference or serving experience is a plus, not a requirement. Prior work with vLLM, production LLM deployments, or serving systems will help you ramp up faster. Location and Remote This role is based in our Paris or London offices (hybrid). We will prioritize candidates who reside in the Paris area or are open to relocating. We strongly believe in the value of in-person collaboration to foster strong relationships and seamless communication within our team. For senior profiles, we will also consider remote candidates based in France. In that case, we ask all new hires to visit our Paris office: - For the first week of their onboarding (accommodation and travel covered) - Then at least 3 days per month WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Engineering Lead – AI Enablement (m/f/d)
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team AI Enablement builds Raisin's internal AI platform. We make it easy and safe for every team, from engineering and product to business operations, to use AI in their daily work and in the products they build. We provide the shared foundation for that: governed access to AI models and tools, the controls that keep data secure and usage auditable, and the visibility teams need to run AI reliably and cost-effectively. We also shape how Raisin builds software with AI, from AI-assisted coding to agentic workflows that support teams across the development lifecycle. Because Raisin operates in regulated financial services, security and compliance are core to how we design the platform. The team is growing, and you will shape both what it builds and how it works. Your Responsibilities As Engineering Lead, you lead the engineers who build Raisin's internal AI platform and drive the company's AI-assisted engineering practices. You are accountable for the team's delivery, growth, and maintaining the AI platform users' trust. You stay close to the technology, because in a field that changes this quickly, good leadership decisions depend on understanding the technical details. Lead and grow the team Hire, onboard, and develop engineers, and build a team that works autonomously across platform engineering, infrastructure, and AI. Hold regular 1:1s, set clear expectations, and agree individual development plans with each engineer. Give timely feedback, recognise strong performance, and address low performance early. Create an environment of trust, open communication, and continuous learning, so the team keeps up with a fast-moving field without burning out. Own delivery and operations Own end-to-end delivery, from planning and estimation through implementation and release, balancing new capabilities with reliability and maintenance. Make sure the platform runs well in production: on-call, incident handling, and service levels for the systems other teams rely on. Spot risks and blockers early and resolve them, or escalate in time with a clear proposal. Turn the AI strategy into quarterly goals and a roadmap the team commits to, together with your manager and stakeholders. Run the platform as a product Work with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to understand their needs and decide what the platform should offer next. Measure adoption, reliability, cost, and impact, and use that data in planning and when reporting to leadership. Manage the cost of AI usage and tooling, including budgets, licences, vendor relationships, and build-versus-buy decisions. Shape the technical direction Work with the team's tech leads on architecture and key technical decisions, and stay hands-on in design discussions, reviews, and selected implementation work. Work with security, legal, and compliance colleagues to keep the platform and the company's use of AI secure and compliant. Help engineering teams across Raisin adopt AI in their work through documentation, workshops, and direct support. Your Profile What you bring 3+ years leading engineers as an Engineering Manager, Engineering Lead, or Team Lead, including hiring and performance management. 7+ years in software engineering overall, with a background in backend, platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling. Experience leading a team that builds for internal customers, such as a platform, developer tooling, or shared services used by other engineers. A track record of delivering production systems that other teams depend on, including ownership of their reliability. A practical understanding of modern AI integration, such as LLM APIs, AI coding assistants, and agentic workflows, deep enough to evaluate technical decisions and challenge the team. You use AI tools in your own work. Clear communication with engineers, product, and business stakeholders, and fluency in English. Nice to have Experience with AI platform topics such as model access, governance, observability, rate limiting, or cost management. You have driven adoption of new tools or practices across an engineering organisation. Experience leading distributed or hybrid teams. Experience in a regulated industry such as banking or fintech. You don't need to tick every box. If you have led a platform or developer-tooling team and you are excited about what AI changes for engineering, we would like to hear from you. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year. Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days. A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%. Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month. Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs. Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office. You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. items.title: CRM Manager - Sportsbook Global Promotions
items.description: Excellent opportunity to join Betsson Group as our new CRM Global Promotions Manager - Sportsbook THE WOW Betsson Group is seeking a self-driven and detail-oriented CRM expert with a "can-do" attitude to join our Global CRM & Engagement department. This is a fantastic opportunity to become part of an amazing team of CRM and sports enthusiasts. In this role, you are responsible for ensuring the successful end-to-end delivery of Sportsbook Global Promotions designed to engage and entertain the group’s wider customer base beyond the game play. In this role you are responsible for promotions such as The Million, Sportsbook Leaderboards, and prize draws, all with big headline prizes aimed to offer an attractive ‘shop window’ to achieve brand loyalty. To be successful in this role, you need a strong understanding of various sports, competitions, and leagues both globally and in Betsson’s key markets, along with a genuine passion for sports to understand what drives and motivates customers. THE CHALLENGE: You will definitely be busy! Here is a taste of what you will be involved with: Sportsbook Promotions Calendar: Design the CRM global promotions calendar, focusing on above-the-line, open-to-all, onsite campaigns centred around major global and local sporting events. Price Boosts: Ensure a competitive Price Boost offering on popular global and local sports, competitions & leagues. Project Management: Use JIRA to efficiently manage global promotions projects and tasks, and to maintain effective communications with all teams and relevant stakeholders. Engagement: Boost campaign participation by experimenting with creatives, copy, layouts, channels, reward types, and reward values. CRM Budget & Optimisation: Manage the CRM spend budget for global promotions, collaborating with CRM Analytics to continuously fine-tune campaigns to achieve improved customer retention and performance. Leadership: Lead a team of CRM Coordinators responsible for flawlessly executing global promotions across all CRM channels. Motivate and guide the team by setting clear goals and objectives, addressing knowledge gaps, and arranging CRM training as needed. Quality Assurance: Ensure that all global promotions are executed on-brand with high quality output, whilst maintaining Betsson Groups high standards for competition fairness and integrity. Localisation & Compliance: Optimise CRM plans to be relevant and localised for each market and collaborate with local market teams to understand key events, competitor activity, regulatory requirements, limitations, and local trends. When required, run highly localised onsite promotions in collaboration with a local market. Process Improvement: Identify opportunities for campaign and process improvement within your team and the broader department, quantify their impact, and drive implementation. Cross-Team Collaboration: Keep acquisition and regional teams informed about big headline promotions suitable for external marketing channels. Work closely with the Support team to optimise campaign customer journeys to reduce contact-drivers. Stakeholder Reporting: Provide reporting to senior stakeholders on the success of Sportsbook global promotions, demonstrating a deep understanding of what motivates Sportsbook customers. CRM & VIP Analytics: Collaborate with our analytics team to establish cost projections and success metrics for global Sportsbook promotions. Trading Teams: Collaborate with the trading team to set competitive prices for Price Boost offering. Local Sportsbook Managers: Work closely with the local Sportsbook Managers to understand key sports events, leagues, and competitions that will be the key activity drivers in their market. CRM Projects & Solutions: Offer feedback on enhancements to CRM tools and new player reward types and features. Conduct testing for new CRM product releases. Regions: Collaborate with local copywriters to ensure full localisation of global promotions material, transforming global mechanics into local messages. Design & Branding: Work with the branding and design team on the propositions of promotions, to ensure creative output in line with promotional goals. YOU ARE GOOD AT: Minimum of 4 years’ CRM experience, ideally from a similar role in the igaming industry. Experience from working in a multi-brand and/or multi-market environment. Proven people management experience. Good understanding of player bonuses and incentives. Excellent ability to interpret CRM data and derive actionable insights. Proficiency in CRM tools and email marketing platforms, ideally from Salesforce or Xtremepush. Strong understanding of various sports, competitions, and leagues both globally and in Betsson’s key markets, along with a genuine passion for sports to understand what drives and motivates customers. Great project management skills, enabling you to handle multiple campaigns and tasks concurrently. Results-driven and customer-focused mindset. Excellent written and verbal skills in English and Spanish. WHAT IS IN IT FOR ME? Much like riding a rollercoaster, sometimes life at Betsson can be lightning fast with twists and turns but always FUN! We recognise it may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you’re a go-getter, initiator and adrenaline junkie, always striving to push the boundaries and challenge yourself, then you’ll fit right in. We offer numerous challenges where your skills will be put to good use! We encourage innovation, independence and celebrate success where you will be part of multi-cultural and diverse company, with people from all over the world. CHALLENGE ACCEPTED? By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy

items.title: Digital Designer
items.location_text: New York, New York, United States
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team The Design team at Raisin brings together product designers and brand & marketing designers. We are united by a shared belief in respect, creativity, and our purpose to give people financial peace of mind. As our Digital Brand Designer, you'll join the Brand & Acquisition team. We shape how Raisin looks, moves, and feels across every market we operate in: paid and organic social, our websites, product launches, and campaigns. You'll report to the Head of Brand and Marketing Design and work integrated with the US Marketing team. Your main focus is conversion: designing and testing the landing pages, web journeys, and creative that turn interest into sign-ups. You'll also support broader marketing initiatives across paid social, web, and email, so Raisin feels consistent across the funnel. Your Responsibilities Conversion-Driven Web Design: Design, test, and optimize high-converting landing pages, reusable UI components, and end-to-end user journeys that elevate the brand and drive growth, while governing overall website design standards and brand alignment. Data-Informed Experimentation & Testing: Partner with Marketing to turn hypotheses into A/B and multivariate tests, from concept to shipped variant, and iterate based on the results, using funnel analytics, heatmaps, test results, and customer insights to find friction and decide what to test next. Creative Production: Produce static and animated creative, from hero assets to fast, iterative test variations within our brand design. Email & CRM: Design email templates and email campaigns with the CRM team, from lifecycle journeys to product launches. Templates & Systems: Build and maintain reusable templates, modules, and patterns for web, ads, and email, working with Product Design and the Raisin Design System so marketing and product feel like one brand. End-to-End Ownership: Act as a solution-oriented design partner, independently guiding cross-functional stakeholders from problem to execution, taking projects from brief to launch, including prototypes and leveraging AI for implementation-ready tests. Stakeholder Management: Present and explain design decisions with confidence, connecting them to the brand, the customer, and the business result. Workflow Innovation: Use AI tools across concepting, variant production, prototyping, test-implementation and analysis to work faster and test more, without compromising visual quality or compliance. Your Profile 4+ years in digital, marketing or web design, ideally in-house at a fintech, DTC or fast-growing tech company, or at an agency with performance clients. A portfolio that shows strong visual craft across brand, web, landing pages, paid social and email, and that tells the story behind the work: the problem, the hypothesis, what you tested and what changed. items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works. Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations. This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve. This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees In this role, you will: - Partner directly with enterprise and digital native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria. - Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes. - Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators. - Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance. - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution. - Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact. - Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback. - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, product engineering or technical consulting. - Are fluent in both French and English - Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or engineering of production systems—not only program or stakeholder management. - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable. - Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment. - Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost. - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. - Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives. - Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments. - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required. items.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, VectorDB
items.location_text: New York City, NY | Seattle, WA; San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is looking for a Staff+ Software Engineer to work on the vector search infrastructure behind Claude. Retrieval is how Claude learns about the world. Web search across claude.ai, the API and agentic surfaces, memory across conversations, and the reinforcement learning workloads that train our next models all depend on fast, cheap, high-recall nearest-neighbor search over billions of vectors. You'll join a small team responsible for the vector database layer that serves Claude's retrieval workloads: its architecture, performance, scalability and cost. This is a foundational role. The team is small, core architectural decisions are still open, and the engineers who join now will shape how the system evolves. The role sits in our Databases organization and works day to day with the Search Platform team, which owns web search indexing, retrieval and serving, and the Memory & Search team, which owns search and memory inside claude.ai. We're looking for someone who has built vector or search systems that ran in production, at scale, with real users and a real on-call. You'll be hands-on in the code, and you'll also be the person deciding how the pieces fit together. Key responsibilities Own the core of Anthropic's vector database layer: index structures, storage layout, query execution and the serving layer Own production readiness - benchmarking against exact search, capacity planning, onboarding new workloads, and the operational tooling to run it at scale Drive the recall, latency and cost trade-offs - quantization, filtered search, index build and refresh strategy, and how compute and storage are separated and scaled Scale throughput by an order of magnitude as research and training demand grows, and work out whether the bottleneck is architecture, hardware or engineering bandwidth Extend the retrieval stack toward hybrid retrieval - lexical search and fused ranking alongside vector search Set the evaluation methodology for the system - recall targets, latency objectives, cost per query, and the regression detection that keeps them honest Set technical direction for a growing team - lead design reviews, make architectural decisions others build on, and mentor the engineers joining the effort Share the on-call for the systems you own Minimum qualifications Direct experience building a vector database or approximate nearest-neighbor search system that ran in production at scale Deep knowledge of ANN index structures (graph-based, clustering-based or disk-resident approaches), vector quantization and filtered search Experience with search relevance and ranking Strong systems programming skills in a language such as Rust, C++ or Go, including performance-critical and memory-intensive code Experience designing and operating large-scale distributed storage or serving systems with strict latency and reliability requirements A track record of independently scoping and delivering ambiguous, multi-quarter technical projects Strong written and verbal communication, with experience driving alignment across teams with different priorities Interest in AI safety and Anthropic's mission Preferred qualifications Experience with object-storage-backed or disaggregated compute and storage database designs Experience building or operating full-text search engines (inverted indexes, BM25) or hybrid retrieval systems Familiarity with embedding models and the retrieval demands of LLM training and inference Experience using GPUs or other accelerators for index build or search Prior experience as a technical lead on a database or search infrastructure team The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Knowledge of government contract and subcontract processes including flow downs, change management, inspection, acceptance, payment, warranty, close-out and records retention. items.title: Technical Program Manager, AI Delivery for Public Sector & Defense, Germany
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why This Role? We're seeking an experienced Program Manager to join Cohere's customer-facing Program Management team, with a focus on public sector and defence accounts in Europe, particularly in Germany. This is a highly specialised role requiring an individual who understands technical program delivery, the technical complexity of frontier AI models and the unique requirements of government and defence organisations. You will be the critical bridge between our cutting-edge AI capabilities and the specific needs of Ministries, Agencies, and defence organisations across Europe. You'll navigate complex procurement processes, stringent security requirements, data sovereignty concerns, and regulatory compliance while ensuring our customers successfully deploy and scale our AI solutions. In this role, you'll collaborate with our Strategic Customer team, Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform, Product, and Go-to-Market teams, serving as the technical program lead and trusted advisor for our most sensitive and high-impact government and defence engagements. Location: Germany Eligibility: This individual must be a German citizen living in Germany and fluent in German, enabling immediate engagement with critical defense and national security customers. Security Clearance: German security clearance is not required, but is a strong nice-to-have. What You'll Do Customer Program Leadership: - Own end-to-end technical program delivery for Germany and broader European public sector and defence customers, from initial deployment through production scaling - Serve as the primary technical program point of contact for customers, building trusted relationships with departmental CIOs, IT directors, and technical teams - Translate complex public sector and defence requirements (security, compliance, accessibility, bilingualism, data sovereignty) into actionable engineering plans - Navigate complex procurement processes, RFP responses, and contractual technical obligations. Strategic Communication: - Provide clear, timely, and objective communication across Cohere's engineering organisation, customer stakeholders, pubic sector and defence leadership - Translate between AI/ML technical concepts and government-appropriate language for decision-makers who may not have deep technical backgrounds - Present technical roadmaps and status updates to senior stakeholders including departmental executives - Represent Cohere's technical capabilities in sensitive government and defence contexts. Complex Program Management: - Create and manage project schedules that account for public sector and defence timelines, security review processes, and approval cycles - Identify and manage dependencies across government departments, security authorities, cloud service providers, and internal Cohere teams - Navigate risks unique to government and defence deployments: privacy compliance, security, political and regulatory, technology and infrastructure. - Drive alignment between product development priorities and specific customer requirements. Technical Delivery & Execution: - Ensure on-time delivery of AI solutions that meet security, privacy, accessibility, and performance standards - Coordinate technical work across multiple teams: model customisation, security hardening, integration with government systems, bilingual support - Establish governance checkpoints appropriate for high-stakes government and defence deployments - Problem-solve complex technical challenges in air-gapped, on-premises, or highly regulated environments. You May Be a Good Fit If: Required Experience: - 6+ years of experience as a customer-facing Technical or Engineering Program Manager in AI/ML consulting, technology transformation, or enterprise software delivery. - Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management. - Experience working with government, defence, or heavily regulated customers. - Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder technical programs with stringent compliance requirements. - Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; advanced degree or technical certs a plus. Technical Background: - Strong understanding of enterprise software deployment architectures (cloud, on-premises, hybrid, air-gapped) - Working knowledge of or experience with modern AI: LLMs, agentic systems, MCP, RAG, fine-tuning, evals, and responsible AI would be a strong differentiator - Comfortable discussing API integrations, model inference, data pipelines, and ML operations with technical stakeholders. Government & Defence Acumen: - Deep understanding of how government and defence organisations procure, evaluate, and deploy technology - Familiarity with European government requirements: data sovereignty, privacy laws (Privacy Act), accessibility standards, official languages obligations, security classifications - Understanding of defence and national security considerations in AI deployment - Experience with Algorithmic Impact Assessments or AI ethics frameworks is a strong asset - Eligible to obtain a German security clearance Nice to Have: - Active German security clearance - Bilingual (English/German) proficiency - Background in or strong familiarity with European defence, intelligence, or critical infrastructure sectors - Experience with GC Cloud services (Azure, AWS GovCloud) or Protected B/C environments - Project management certification (PMP, PgMP) or government-specific methodologies. Security Clearance Requirements This role strongly prefers eligibility for German government security clearance. We are looking for candidates eligible for German government clearance, meaning that they require German citizenship. In addition, this individual is required to be based in Germany and be fluent in German as this will enable immediate engagement with critical defence and national security customers. What Makes This Role Unique This isn't typical program management - it's a highly specialised role at the intersection of frontier AI, national security, and public sector digital transformation. You'll work on some of Canada's most sensitive and impactful AI deployments, helping government organisations harness cutting-edge technology while maintaining the highest standards of security, ethics, and accountability. If you're passionate about responsible AI adoption, understand the unique constraints and opportunities within government, and want to have an outsized impact on how Canada leverages AI to serve its citizens, this role is for you. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.description: Kick-start your career in the online gaming world and experience the very latest in technology and innovation. Who we are We’re Super Group, the NYSE-listed digital gaming company behind some of the world’s leading Sports and iGaming brands, including Betway and Jackpot City. We’re a powerhouse built on decades of expertise across 22 countries – and with over 2,800 bright minds, we’re changing the game for good. Our mission is to give our customers a superclass entertainment experience. Who we’re looking for We’re on a thrilling journey of growth and innovation, and we need passionate, driven individuals to join us. At Super Group, every day is action-packed, and we expect you to bring your A-game. In return, you’ll find a supportive environment where your skills can flourish and your career can soar. Ready to become a game-changer? Supercharge your career with us and be part of something extraordinary. Why we need you We’re building experiences that wow our customers – and that starts with bold, curious people who want to do work that matters. If you’re hungry to grow, excited by impact and ready for a challenge that will supercharge your career, this could be your moment. As our Programmatic & Display Specialist , you’ll play a key part to support the planning, execution, and optimisation of programmatic and display advertising campaigns. This role is ideal for someone with a strong interest in performance marketing and iGaming media buying, who is eager to build technical buying and optimisation skills across display networks and DSPs. Your drive and ideas will help us move faster, improve smarter, and stay ahead of the game. Our Performance tool ensures you get meaningful feedback to support your development and superdrive your career. Support that has your back . Our Employee Assistance Programme offers resources for you and your family. Ready to feel superclass? At Super Group, your experience matters. We’re honest, fair, and focused on helping you succeed – and your work will have real impact from day one. Game on!
